keys.name: OFFSET_READY
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root is quiet and rear-biased; sword is low-forward but does not own the line.
keys.causal_role: Unequal ready keeps the weapon visible without making it the body's master.

keys.name: LOW_REAR_COIL
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Pelvis sinks down/back while chest counter-rotates; blade folds behind the front line.
keys.causal_role: Asymmetric coil stores pelvis torque and moves the sword out of the future tangent lane.

keys.name: PELVIS_DRIVE_BRIDGE
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Pelvis crosses neutral before the blade claims forward space.
keys.causal_role: Authored body-first bridge makes the strike emerge from root travel rather than arm extension.

keys.name: DIAGONAL_ENTRY
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root advances while the sword accelerates last on a rising diagonal.
keys.causal_role: Directional entry establishes a nonhorizontal tool path and growing negative-space claim.

keys.name: PRECONTACT_GAP
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Pelvis and shoulder are committed while the blade remains visibly short of the deflector.
keys.causal_role: Distinct precontact preserves the instant at which the force axis changes.

keys.name: OBLIQUE_CONTACT
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Blade tip reaches the diagonal deflector while root remains behind the line.
keys.causal_role: Explicit glancing impact/hit-stop candidate; contact creates a new tangent without pinning the tool.

keys.name: TANGENT_SLIP
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Tip exits sharply up-right along the deflector tangent while pelvis still advances right.
keys.causal_role: Core fork: tool direction rotates immediately after contact while body momentum has not yet rotated.

keys.name: TORSO_YAW_OVERDRIVE
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root continues forward as chest yaws toward the new tangent; rear heel lightens.
keys.causal_role: Body consequence arrives after the redirected tool, showing angular debt entering the torso.

keys.name: REAR_FOOT_PIVOT_CATCH
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Rear foot steps inward and re-plants; pelvis drops while front foot becomes a pivot.
keys.causal_role: Support finally catches the rotated force axis instead of reversing the incoming path.

keys.name: TOOL_TIP_OVERSHOOT
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Pelvis begins counter-yaw but the blade tip continues high/left across the new arc.
keys.causal_role: Secondary tool lag proves the sword carries angular momentum after the body begins arresting it.

keys.name: SHOULDER_REINDEX
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Chest rotates back before the sword; hands compress toward the body.
keys.causal_role: Grip and shoulder reorganize after the catch rather than rewinding the strike.

keys.name: TIP_LAG_SETTLE
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Torso restacks while the blade remains high and late.
keys.causal_role: Tool-tip lag survives one authored beat after body recovery begins.

keys.name: DISPLACED_ROTATED_SETTLE
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root settles forward/right of opening stance and the sword finishes low across the body.
keys.causal_role: Recovery debt remains visible in rotated stance and blade placement.

keys.name: REENTRY_WITH_ANGULAR_DEBT
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Action eligibility returns without restoring the original support width or sword line.
keys.causal_role: Re-entry is ready but the glancing-contact history remains legible.

rounds.highest_value_visible_defect: The first actual render let the sword rotate more dramatically than the body; through entry/contact/slip the torso stayed too upright, so the glancing hit read as tool-only motion rather than force-axis debt entering the root.
rounds.concrete_correction: Deepen the rear/down coil, make K3-K6 pelvis/chest lines progressively oblique, widen the contact brace, drive K6-K7 chest/root farther through while the tip exits the tangent, then make K8 a low pivot catch and K9 preserve high tool-tip overshoot against a body already counter-yawing.

No source art, arm-only causality, reverse interpolation, idle reset, or generic causal bridge is used.
